observations: Final continuous 0.12 mm retraction removes the first trial's extra upper groove and double bright lip rim.

No prominent new patch edge or fold was seen in the inspected front, oblique, side and grazing-light renders.
The original mouth details and a visible lower lip remain. The change is a modest reduction of forward lip relief, not a completely erased lip or a guaranteed elimination of perceived pouting.
Exact STL checks prove all vertices outside the small lip support unchanged. The original mouth-seam X/Z path is retained while its Y position retracts with the lip.
